name: cross-agent-teams
description: Local MCP daemon for cross-agent communication (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor)

envVars.name: CROSS_AGENT_TEAMS_TOKEN
envVars.description: Optional bearer token. If set, daemon must be started with the same --token, and ALL agent headers must include it (no fallback to no-auth — any mismatch returns 401).

prerequisites.description: Start the daemon (long-running). Keep it alive in tmux/launchd/dedicated terminal.
notes: Daemon MUST be running before any agent client connects (Claude Code's stdio channel proxy fails to register otherwise).

postInstallNotes: Start the daemon BEFORE launching Claude Code; otherwise the stdio channel proxy fails to register.
Launch Claude Code with: claude --dangerously-load-development-channels server:cross-agent-teams-channel
The 'server:<name>' suffix MUST equal the MCP server key 'cross-agent-teams-channel' above.
Codex receives messages via mailbox by default — no extra setup required.
(Optional, for real-time push wake-up of an existing Codex thread) Run: codex app-server --listen ws://127.0.0.1:8799 in one terminal, and codex --remote ws://127.0.0.1:8799 in another.
Run inside tmux so the daemon can resolve pid → tty → pane on register and deliver pokes.
Cursor runs as a GUI app outside tmux; cross-agent pokes will queue in mailbox only — call get_inbox manually or rely on Cursor's MCP tooling polling.
